# KafkaBrokerFenced

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| warning | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 5m / 30s |

**Summary:** Cluster <kafka_cluster> has fenced brokers

The active controller fenced at least one broker because its heartbeats stopped. A fenced broker leads no partitions; if it is running, it cannot reach the controller quorum.

## Impact

Fenced brokers lead no partitions; their load shifts to the others and their replicas drop out of ISRs.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · KRaft → Broker registration state; is the broker running but unable to heartbeat (network, GC pause > broker.session.timeout.ms)?

## Mitigation

- Restore connectivity / resources; the broker unfences itself after a successful heartbeat.

## Expression

```promql
max by (kafka_cluster) (kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_fencedbrokercount) > 0
```
